'''CT-66-3238''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] and part of [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]]. When [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] arrived to supervise the graduation tests of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadets]], Bravo Squad was the first team to take the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]]. During this challenge, the cadets worked as a team and got close to the citadel. [[CT-66-3339/Legends|CT-66-3339]] then told him to go for the tower while the others covered him. CT-66-3238 succeeded and Bravo Squad finished the course in record time.<ref name="Clone Cadets" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Bravo Squad cadet's identification number was first depicted in the episode "[[Clone Cadets]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. It says 66-3238, and the prefix CT- was predetermined. This way of determining identification numbers was proved with the troopers in [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]].
